d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, Ganesh Chaturthi aa rahi hai, ekdam Special wale Gehu ke aate se Modak banane ki recipe share kar raha hu, ye bhai dry modak hai aur lambe time tak chalte hai 5-7 din tak aap bana kar rakh sakte ho, aur khane me super hote hai, bahar se crispy aur andar coconut ka dry saran rehta hai. Aap bhi try kariega!
Ingredients:
Atta - 1 Katori
Maida - 1 Katori
Salt - 1 pinch
Melted Ghee - 2 tbsp
Water - to make dough
